title: Go-live hourglass prep notes and staff vignette (Apr 2026)
body:
Purpose:
This note is a compact, human-first hourglass plan for the Apr 2026 go-live. The goal is to give the on-call / launch crew a living checklist + an annotated hourly cadence (vignettes) that surface the small but high-risk handoffs that are easy to miss in long playbooks. Treat as canonical for this launch window unless overwritten in Slack #release-ops.

Summary objectives:
- Deploy service v2.9.0 with model-routing fallback for eu-west and us-west shards.
- Keep tail latency P95 < 220ms for text-gen endpoints during the first 6 hours post-traffic shift.
- No customer-facing errors above baseline; if error rate > 0.5% for 10m, begin canary rollback.

Release window (primary):
- Start: 2026-04-09 02:00 UTC (preflight)
- Traffic shift stage 1: 2026-04-09 04:30 UTC (10% traffic)
- Traffic shift stage 2: 2026-04-09 05:30 UTC (50% traffic)
- Full shift: 2026-04-09 06:30 UTC
- Stabilization window: 06:30–12:30 UTC (6h)

Hourglass schedule (annotated micro-vignettes):
- T-120 to T-30 (02:00–03:30 UTC): Engineering warmup + infra checks
  * Vignette: Marco runs the quick-netcheck script and notes an iptables rule that occasionally drops ephemeral ports on staging; add preflight rule override to puppet and re-run test.
  * Actions: Verify deploy candidates exist in staging bucket; verify canary config maps for model-routing present.

- T-30 to T-0 (03:30–04:00 UTC): Smoke test group 1 (control plane)
  * Vignette: Sofia walks through console UI toggles while Priya watches metrics; small UI latency blip expected during memcache warm.
  * Actions: Run control-plane smoke list (auth, quota-check, model-resolve). All green needed.

- T+30 (04:30 UTC): Stage 1 traffic shift (10%)
  * Vignette: First 10% often surfaces hidden kv-cache cache population regressions — watch cache-hit-rate, redis latency.
  * Actions: Check token-per-request histogram and error logs. If any increase in 5xx over baseline, pause shift.

- T+90 (05:30 UTC): Stage 2 traffic shift (50%)
  * Vignette: Load generator shows modest p95 lift; if < 20% over baseline and error rate normal, proceed.

- T+150 (06:30 UTC): Full shift; begin stabilization window
  * Vignette: At full shift, schedule a 15m sync on Slack between SRE and serving-runtime leads to confirm tail-latency and transient error sampling.

- Stabilization cadence (06:30–12:30 UTC): Rolling checks every 30m for first 2h, then hourly notes
  * Actions: Run the 10-check smoke suite every 30m for first 2h. If any check fails twice in a row, open incident runbook.

Preflight checklist (quick pass — individual owners in parens):
- [ ] Confirm canary image sha is pinned in k8s manifests (Marco)
- [ ] Verify DB-migrations are backward compatible and tested in staging (Daniel)
- [ ] Load-test sample 1: 1k qps short-run against canary (Sofia)
- [ ] Validate model-routing fallback tables for eu/us regions (Priya)
- [ ] Confirm alert pages and escalation list updated (Aisha)
- [ ] Verify secrets rotation happened in last 72h (infra)
- [ ] Backup config: snapshot kafka topic offsets and store in GCS with timestamp (Marco)
- [ ] Confirm on-call Slack + phone roster for 06:30–12:30 UTC (Aisha)

Observability smoke tests (10 quick probes):
1) Ping /health -> 200 within 100ms (avg)
2) Auth check -> no regression in 401/403 rates
3) Token billing meter -> increments for synthetic requests
4) KV cache hit rate -> baseline ±5%
5) Redis latency P99 < 20ms
6) Downstream model host error rate < 0.3%
7) Request queue length per worker < 8
8) Error budget burn rate steady < 1.5x baseline
9) Latency P95 per route < 220ms
10) Trace sampling ingest confirmed into trace-store

Rollforward and rollback criteria (short):
- Rollforward: If stabilization metrics meet SLOs for 90m and no critical alerts, proceed to full traffic and close launch window at +6h.
- Immediate rollback triggers:
  * Sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 10m
  * Latency P95 > 400ms for 5m
  * Critical downstream outage (model-host unhealthy)
  * Data integrity alerts from DB-migration checker
- Rollback steps (if triggered):
  1) Pause traffic shift, set routing to pre-deploy pin
  2) Revert k8s deployment to last stable image sha
  3) Notify customers and CS with templated note (draft below)
  4) Run post-rollback smoke and decide next steps

Post-release validation tasks (first 6h):
- Run quality spot-check: 20 random prompt-responses across top 5 customer-profiles and compare against baseline outputs (SRE + Applied ML).
- Cost telemetry: verify per-token cost delta within expected band for new quantization changes.
- Billing ingestion: first hourly ingestion job produces expected volumetrics.
- Customer error digest: aggregate any customer-facing errors into #release-ops.

Draft release notes (internal -> external light version appended below):
- New: model-routing fallback for regional load spikes (eu-west/us-west) — reduces cold-start fallout and enables faster failover.
- Improvement: KV-cache warming heuristics optimized for small-sequence prompts; expect 7–12% token cost reduction for short chat-style workloads.
- Fix: rare auth-proxy timeout during heavy quota-check bursts (fixed by batching logic).
- Known limitation: A small cohort on very long sequence workloads (>4096 tokens) may see minor p99 increases; we are tracking in post-launch eval.

External customer-facing blurb (for support/CS to use if asked):
"Today we rolled out a backend update that improves regional failover and cache warming. Most customers should see similar or lower latency and reduced token costs for short interactions. If you notice increased errors or latency, please reach out to support with a sample request-id and timestamp."

Open questions / quick actions (who/ETA):
- Q: Should we enable the new cold-start metrics dashboard by default? (Aisha) ETA: +1d
- Q: Confirm SLO change for P95 target after quantization (Product + SRE) (Priya) ETA: EOD
- Action: Add a synthetic test that exercises the new fallback path every 10m for first week (Marco)

Small field notes (less formal — read on shift):
- If you see a single-region error spike right after stage 1, check redis eviction logs before panicking; often transient due to cache thrash during prefix warming.
- We added a small 2s grace to the model-host negotiation during low concurrency; this reduces noisy retries but can mask slowness — watch aggregated retry counts.

Signoff checklist (to mark at end of stabilization window):
- [ ] All smoke tests pass for last 2 consecutive runs
- [ ] No rollbacks performed
- [ ] Post-launch plan assigned (owner + ticket)
- [ ] Release notes draft published to confluence and support template ready

Appendix: quick contact roster (for this window)
- Launch lead: Aisha Patel (Slack: @aisha, mobile: +1-555-0189)
- Serving-runtime: Marco Lin (@marco)
- Observability / SRE: Sofia Ramirez (@sofia)
- Applied ML / model fallback: Priya Nair (@priya)
- DB/Storage: Daniel Kim (@daniel)

End of note. Keep this doc lightweight: if you add tactical steps, put a short timestamped line and your initials. This lives as the single-step operational checklist for the Apr 09 2026 hourglass launch.
